name: lease takes tasks and returns them with their data
description: POST /api/queue/lease is how a worker takes ownership of runnable tasks. The lease owner travels in the X-Lease-Owner header, not the body, because it identifies the caller; the body carries only the limit. The response is an array of tasks, each carrying its data payload — the one place data is returned, so a worker need not fetch it separately. Because the seeded queue is not empty, at least one task comes back; leaseOwner on it is the header value. An empty queue would answer data:[] instead.
